query: I just picked up a fresh batch of homemade chocolate chip cookies from the local bakery down the street this afternoon, they’re still warm and the melty chocolate oozes out every time you take a bite. I also spent an hour rearranging the potted succulents on my windowsill earlier, I moved the little zebra haworthia right next to the string of pearls so they both get the perfect amount of morning sun now. Oh, and I was watching that new cozy gardening show on streaming last night, they had the coolest tutorial on how to propagate pothos cuttings in just a glass of water, I can’t wait to try it this weekend. Anyway, I’m having some trouble with my mobile service, I noticed airplane mode is turned on right now, my APN settings seem to be messed up so I can’t connect to data at all, my SIM card is locked and asking for a PIN I can’t remember off the top of my head, and I think my line might be suspended because I forgot to pay my overdue bill last month. Can you help me figure out how to get my phone working again?
